connector.name: Opedd - Licensed Content for AI
connector.registryDescription: Licensed, rights-cleared content for AI agents - verifiable license keys + EU AI Act attestation.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.opedd.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package opedd-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.opedd, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer <your Opedd key> (opedd_pub_* publisher, opedd_buyer_* buyer, or ent_* enterprise). Public discovery tools work without auth.

env.name: OPEDD_BUYER_EMAIL
env.description: Your email — default buyer identity for purchases

env.name: OPEDD_PAYMENT_METHOD_ID
env.description: Stripe PaymentMethod id (pm_...) for autonomous per-article purchasing

env.name: OPEDD_BUYER_TOKEN
env.description: Buyer API token (opedd_buyer_live_*) — enables licensed content retrieval

env.name: OPEDD_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Enterprise access key (ent_*) — enables bulk feed tools

env.name: OPEDD_BUYER_JWT
env.description: Buyer portal session JWT — enables account, audit, compliance + EU AI Act attestation tools

env.name: OPEDD_PUB_BEARER
env.description: Publisher API key (opedd_pub_*) — enables publisher content push + listing tools
